svg.title: OutGuess: baseline compared with the guarded build
svg.desc: 31 successful exits remain successful, five rejections remain rejections, and 41 abnormal exits become explicit guard rejections. All 77 output byte streams remain identical. Successful exit does not authenticate a payload.
